- Review security/compliance expectations (data residency, audit logs, auth)
- Agree on a short pilot checklist and immediate next steps

- Wed Apr 28, 09:00–10:15 PT (12:00–1:15 ET) — 75m (happy medium)
- Wed Apr 28, 14:00–15:00 PT (17:00–18:00 ET) — 60m

Request from our side before the session:
- Final roster (names + emails + roles) so we bring the right engineers (ops, infra, security).
- Any non-production sample payloads or a short description of sequence length / token mix so we can prep perf numbers.
- Any must-see security artifacts (SOC2 section, EDR requirements) or a short checklist we should pre-review.

Attachments: redwood_precall_checklist.pdf (short agenda + pre-call asks), StratusAI_Security_QA.xlsx (your answers from today)

I'll loop in Jordan (infra lead) and Marissa (solutions) to confirm available engineers. If a quick 20-minute pre-call between infra leads helps, say the word and we can schedule that for the day before.
